title: Example full-stack feature
objective: Add a project-aware feature through the domain, API, client, user interface, and focused verification layers.
completion_standard: The feature works end to end for two isolated projects.
Failure, permission, empty, and recovery states are tested.
One mechanical integration pass and cross-lane verification pass on the recorded baseline.
stop_boundary: Stop after one mechanical integration pass and an accepted common baseline; do not publish or deploy.

tasks.title: Domain and API vertical
tasks.description: Implement project-aware domain state, service behavior, API contracts, and generated-client synchronization.
verification: Run the focused service/API/client test command recorded from the repository

tasks.title: User journey
tasks.description: Implement the sole user interface against the generated client, including empty, failure, and recovery states.
verification: Run focused UI tests and production typecheck/build

tasks.title: Phase integration
tasks.description: Integrate owner commits, resolve shared mechanical boundaries, regenerate artifacts, and run focused cross-lane checks.

ownership.non_file_scope: Mechanical integration only; semantic defects return to owners

verification: Verify owner commits and run focused cross-lane tests

milestones.title: Feature milestone
integration_evidence: Recorded integration commit and cross-layer tests

assumptions: Repository commands will be confirmed from local manifests before execution.
unknowns: The host model catalog and maximum concurrency are resolved at runtime.
